definition_en: a very large quantity of something
core_image: 果园里压弯枝条的果子
scene: 秋收时，树上挂满果子，地上也落了一层。 The orchard produced an abundance of apples that year.
sceneCN: 这里的 abundance 指「丰富；大量」（第 1 个义项：数量极多）；句意是那年果园的苹果获得了大丰收。

senses.title: A large quantity
senses.definition: a quantity much greater than enough
senses.definitionCN: 远超所需的数量
senses.example: The orchard produced an abundance of apples that year.
senses.exampleCN: 那年果园的苹果获得了大丰收。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to overflow like a wave, and overflowing is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「如波浪般溢出」，溢出正是核心义。

senses.title: Wealth of resources
senses.definition: the state of having more than one needs
senses.definitionCN: 拥有超过所需之物的状态
senses.example: The region is known for its abundance of water.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区以水资源丰富著称。
senses.why: A land that overflows with goods is called rich, and the noun names that plenty.
senses.whyCN: 物产 overflow 的地方被称作富庶，名词便指这种丰足。

senses.title: In abundance
senses.definition: in the phrase in abundance, existing in large amounts
senses.definitionCN: 在 in abundance 中，指大量存在
senses.example: Fish were found in abundance along the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 沿海一带鱼非常多。
senses.why: The preposition turns the noun into a measure of how something occurs.
senses.whyCN: 介词把名词变成描述事物出现方式的量度。

senses.title: Biological abundance
senses.definition: in ecology, the number of individuals in an area
senses.definitionCN: 生态学上指某地区的个体数量
senses.example: The survey measured the abundance of bees.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查测量了蜜蜂的丰度。
senses.why: Science counts how much life fills a place, extending the old idea of plenty.
senses.whyCN: 科学计量一地生物之多，延续了古老的「丰盛」观念。

senses.title: An abundance of caution
senses.definition: in the phrase an abundance of caution, more care than usual
senses.definitionCN: 在 an abundance of caution 中，指超乎寻常的谨慎
senses.example: The bridge was closed out of an abundance of caution.
senses.exampleCN: 出于格外谨慎，这座桥被关闭了。
senses.why: Even a quality can be had in excess, and the phrase names that excess.
senses.whyCN: 连品质也可以过量，短语便指这种过量。

senses.title: Emotional abundance
senses.definition: a generous flow of feeling or kindness
senses.definitionCN: 情感或善意的充沛流露
senses.example: She greeted every guest with warmth and abundance.
senses.exampleCN: 她以温暖而充沛的热情迎接每位客人。
senses.why: What overflows need not be material, so the noun covers feeling too.
senses.whyCN: 溢出的不必是物质，名词也涵盖情感。

senses.title: An abundance mentality
senses.definition: the belief that there is enough for everyone
senses.definitionCN: 相信资源足够所有人分享的心态
senses.example: The team works well because of its abundance mentality.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队合作良好，靠的是富足心态。
senses.why: A modern coinage treats plenty as a way of seeing the world.
senses.whyCN: 现代新造说法把「丰足」当成一种看世界的方式。

senses.title: Elemental abundance
senses.definition: in chemistry, how common an element is in a sample
senses.definitionCN: 化学上指某元素在样本中的常见程度
senses.example: The spectrograph reported the abundance of iron.
senses.exampleCN: 光谱仪报出了铁的丰度。
senses.why: Measuring how much of an element is present is another technical branch of plenty.
senses.whyCN: 测量某元素存在多少，是「丰盛」的另一技术分支。

definition_zh: 三角形；三角板；三角关系；三角铁
definition_en: a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles, or an object of that shape
core_image: 三根直棍首尾相接，围出一块有三个角的空地
scene: 黑板上，老师用三条直直的粉笔线围出一块封闭的图形，量角器摆在旁边。 Draw a triangle with two equal sides.
sceneCN: 这里 triangle 是「三角形」（第 1 个义项：三条边三个角的平面图形）；句意为画一个两边相等的三角形。三根线首尾相连围出一块地的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 名词换词尾 -ular 构成形容词，义为「三角形的」
由形容词加 -ate 构成动词，义为「用三角测量；使成三角形」
由动词加 -ion 构成名词，义为「三角测量法」

senses.title: A shape with three sides
senses.definition: a flat figure bounded by three straight sides and having three angles
senses.definitionCN: 由三条直边围成、有三个角的平面图形
senses.example: The flag has a red triangle in the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 旗子一角有个红色三角形。
senses.why: The word simply says three angles: tri- is three and gonia is angle in Greek.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面就是「三个角」：tri- 是希腊语的三，gonia 是角。

senses.title: A set square or musical instrument
senses.definition: a flat three-sided tool for drawing or measuring, or a steel rod bent into that shape and struck
senses.definitionCN: 画图测量用的三边形板，或弯成三边形、用来敲击的钢条
senses.example: He played the triangle in the school orchestra.
senses.exampleCN: 他在学校乐队里敲三角铁。
senses.why: An object made in three-sided form takes the name of the form itself.
senses.whyCN: 做成三边形的物件，直接承接了这个形状的名字。

senses.title: A group of three people
senses.definition: a situation in which three people are closely and often awkwardly involved
senses.definitionCN: 三个人紧密牵扯、常常尴尬的局面
senses.example: The novel is built on a love triangle.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说建立在一个三角恋上。
senses.why: Three people pull on one another the way three sides close a figure, so the word pictures the group.
senses.whyCN: 三个人彼此拉扯，正像三条边围住一个图形，于是这个词用来画这种关系。

senses.title: A three-sided area of land or route
senses.definition: a three-sided piece of land, or a route that returns to its start
senses.definitionCN: 呈三角形的地块，或绕回起点的航路
senses.example: The plane flew the triangle between three islands.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机在三座岛之间飞了个三角圈。
senses.why: Any three points can be joined into a closed figure, so a journey among three places borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 任意三点都能连成一个闭合图形，所以三点之间的行程也借用了这个名字。

intro.en: The word is Latin triangulum, a three-cornered figure, from tri-, three, and angulus, a corner.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语 triangulum，即「三角之物」，由 tri-（三）与 angulus（角）构成。

items.en: The root treyes supplies three, and the same root appears in trio and triple.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 treyes 提供「三」，也出现在 trio 与 triple 里。

items.en: Angulus means a corner or an angle, and gives angle, anchor, and anxious through its relatives.
items.cn: 拉丁语 angulus 意为角落、角，其亲族生出 angle、anchor 与 anxious。

items.en: Triangulum means having three corners and is used both of shapes and of land.
items.cn: 拉丁语 triangulum 意为「有三个角」，既指图形也指地块。

items.en: Old French triangle passes the word into English with the plain shape sense.
items.cn: 古法语 triangle 把这个词传入英语，含义就是那个图形。

items.en: Music and later surveying give the word its instrument and its measuring senses.
items.cn: 音乐与后来的测量学给了它乐器和测量用语的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tri- and -angul- pieces, while the near-meaning group gathers other plane figures.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tri- 与 -angul- 两部分，近义组汇集其他平面图形。

normal.cn: 三角恋的三条边彼此拉扯。

normal.en: A triangle in an orchestra is a steel rod struck with a stick.
normal.cn: 乐队里的三角铁是一根被小棒敲的钢条。

abstract.en: Picture three matchsticks laid end to end, closing a small yard.
abstract.cn: 想象三根火柴首尾相接，围出一小块院子。

abstract.en: See the angles as three corners the sticks cannot round off.
abstract.cn: 把三个角想成火柴磨不圆的三处尖角。

abstract.en: Set the same yard on three islands and fly around it.
abstract.cn: 把这块院子搁在三座岛上，再绕它飞一圈。

examples.en: The roof is built from two large triangles.
examples.cn: 屋顶由两个大三角形构成。

examples.en: She tapped the triangle once and the hall fell silent.
examples.cn: 她敲了一下三角铁，礼堂立刻安静下来。

examples.en: Their friendship became a triangle when a third classmate joined.
examples.cn: 第三个同学加入后，他们的友谊成了三角。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「揣安钩」——揣着三个安好的钩子，钩成三角形的三个角。

root: 拉丁语 tri-（三）+ angulus（角），名词 triangulum 经古法语进入英语；同族有 angle、triangular、triple

sensesIntro.en: The word names a shape first, then any object or group that takes that shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词先给形状命名，再给任何取这一形状的物件或群体命名。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three straight sticks closing a small plot of ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：三根直棍围出一小块地。

branches.en: The plain geometric sense, the shape itself.
branches.cn: 朴素几何义：形状本身。

branches.en: The instrument sense, where a made object takes the shape’s name.
branches.cn: 器物义：做成这个形状的东西直接用了名字。

branches.en: The human sense, where three people pull against one another.
branches.cn: 人事义：三个人彼此拉扯。

branches.en: The spatial sense, where land or a route forms the figure.
branches.cn: 空间义：地块或航路形成这个图形。

branches.en: The geometric sense again, where the three corners are what matters.
branches.cn: 再回几何义：关键在三个角。

intro.en: The word joins a Greek-derived number to a Latin word for corner.
intro.cn: 这个词把表示数字的前缀与拉丁语「角」一词连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Angulus is behind angle, triangular, and the whole family of English angle words.
latinIntro.cn: angulus 支撑着 angle、triangular 以及整族英语「角」类词。

items.example: The angle is nearly ninety degrees.

items.exampleCN: 这支三重奏演奏了一整晚。

definition_en: a supporting structure, or a set of rules and ideas that organizes something
core_image: 钢梁交错搭起的骨架，撑起整栋楼
scene: 这座桥的钢框架已经完成。 The steel framework of the bridge is complete.
sceneCN: 这里 framework 是「框架、构架」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这座桥的钢框架已经完成。

senses.title: A supporting structure
senses.definition: the frame that supports a building or object
senses.definitionCN: 支撑建筑或物体的骨架
senses.example: The steel framework of the bridge is complete.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的钢框架已经完成。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的实体义项。

senses.title: A set of rules
senses.definition: a set of rules or agreements that organizes activity
senses.definitionCN: 组织活动的一整套规则或协议
senses.example: The law provides a framework for trade.
senses.exampleCN: 法律为贸易提供了框架。
senses.why: Rules also support action, like beams support a roof.
senses.whyCN: 规则支撑行动，正如梁支撑屋顶。

senses.title: A basic structure of ideas
senses.definition: the basic structure of a theory or study
senses.definitionCN: 理论或研究的基本结构
senses.example: The paper has a clear framework.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文有清晰的结构。
senses.why: Ideas need a skeleton too.
senses.whyCN: 思想也需要骨架。

intro.en: Framework joins frame with work.
intro.cn: framework 由 frame 和 work 组合而成。

items.en: Frame meant a structure.
items.cn: frame 意为结构。

items.en: Framework named the work of framing.
items.cn: framework 指装框或搭建的工作。

items.en: It came to mean a supporting skeleton.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示支撑性的骨架。

items.en: It also named systems of rules.
items.cn: 它也用来指规则体系。

items.en: Scholars used it for theories.
items.cn: 学者用它来指理论结构。

note.en: Framework is compared with similar-looking words and with structure words.
note.cn: 把 framework 与形近词以及结构词作比较。

entries.definition: a border or structure
a group of connected things
school work done at home
the way parts are arranged
a set of connected rules
the frame of bones

normalIntro.en: A framework is the skeleton that supports the rest.
normalIntro.cn: framework 是支撑其余部分的骨架。

normal.en: The steel framework of the bridge is complete.
normal.cn: 这座桥的钢框架已经完成。

normal.en: The law provides a framework for trade.
normal.cn: 法律为贸易提供了框架。

normal.en: The paper has a clear framework.
normal.cn: 这篇论文有清晰的结构。

normal.en: They work within the framework of the rules.
normal.cn: 他们在规则框架内工作。

normal.en: The two sides signed a framework agreement.
normal.cn: 双方签署了框架协议。

abstract.en: A framework is a promise of order.
abstract.cn: 框架是对秩序的承诺。

abstract.en: Bones are quiet until they hold us up.
abstract.cn: 骨头沉默，直到它们撑起我们。

abstract.en: Good rules free people to act.
abstract.cn: 好的规则让人得以行动。

examples.en: The steel framework of the bridge is complete.
examples.cn: 这座桥的钢框架已经完成。

examples.en: The law provides a framework for trade.
examples.cn: 法律为贸易提供了框架。

examples.cn: 这篇论文有清晰的结构。

dict_mnemonic.text: frame（框架）加 work（工作、成品）：成型的框架就是 framework，实体是构架，抽象是体系。

root: 由 frame（框架）加 work 构成，核心义「支撑整体的骨架」。

sensesIntro.en: Framework means a supporting structure, a system of rules, or a basic structure.
sensesIntro.cn: framework 意为框架、规则体系或基本结构。

core.en: The skeleton that holds everything together.
core.cn: 把一切连接起来的骨架。

branches.en: Steel beams hold the bridge.
branches.cn: 钢梁撑起桥梁。

branches.en: Rules organize trade.
branches.cn: 规则组织贸易。

branches.en: A paper needs a clear skeleton.
branches.cn: 论文需要清晰的骨架。

branches.en: Physical and social frames both support.
branches.cn: 实体框架与社会框架都在支撑。

branches.en: Systems and theories share structure.
branches.cn: 体系与理论共享结构。

intro.en: Framework joins the frame family of structure words.
intro.cn: framework 属于 frame 这一结构词族。

latinIntro.en: Framework is Germanic; Latin structura, structure, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: framework 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 structura（结构）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: the act of shaping or framing
items.example: The framing of the question matters.
The study needs a theoretical framework.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究需要理论框架。
